phantom_note: PROPOSAL for a spherical water phantom at 3 T, chosen by the team. Please replace with site values.

starterpack_thresholds_v1_0_scanner_rela.name: mrs_snr
starterpack_thresholds_v1_0_scanner_rela.definition: SNR = height of the NAA peak in the real (absorption) spectrum, 1.9-2.1 ppm, divided by the SD of the real spectrum in the signal-free window -3.0 to 0.0 ppm (peak height / noise SD; LCModel's S/N uses 2 x RMS residual and gives about half)

starterpack_thresholds_v1_0_scanner_rela.name: roi_u_consistency
starterpack_thresholds_v1_0_scanner_rela.rule: for a mask propagated through a registration: stated_u_rel >= implied_u_rel = 3 * registration_rms_mm / r_eq, r_eq = equivalent-sphere radius of the reference ROI (dossier section 3.10)

starterpack_thresholds_v1_0_scanner_rela.name: protocol_match
starterpack_thresholds_v1_0_scanner_rela.rule: same sequence family, TE, TR and field as the baseline

twin_policy.note: R_factor is a declared team policy, not a physical constant (dossier section 7.5)
